Vanessa / Kevin —

Thanks for confirming the slot this morning. I reviewed Novus's markup and attached an updated PDF with inline comments focused on: jurisdiction language, data processing & retention table, and the SLA credit calculation. High-level notes:
- We can accept the shorter retention window for non-sensitive telemetry with vendor-side deletion after 90 days; for PHI they should keep less than 30 days and we will require an Appendix for storage location.
- SLA credit formula: we propose keeping the current SLA but shift the reporting window to calendar month; we can add a 5% credit cap for the first 6 months of the pilot.
- Add a required security attestation (SOC2/ISO) at onboarding and annual thereafter — we can provide supporting evidence during the kickoff.

I suggest we keep the Tue session to 60 minutes and then schedule a 30-minute redline walk-through on Thu Nov 12, 10:00–10:30 PT if needed. That'll give both legal teams time to confirm language.
